children: Overview
US mineral fertilizer producer's Q3 sales were flat yr/yr
Q3 net income rose yr/yr on higher Trio production and improved pricing
Subsequent to quarter end and through October 31, co repurchased an additional 66 thousand shares
Outlook
Company raises 2026 full-year Trio(®) production guidance to 305-315 thousand tons
Company maintains 2026 full-year potash production guidance at 290-300 thousand tons
Company raises 2026 full-year capital expenditures guidance to approximately $45 mln
Result Drivers
TRIO PRODUCTION AND MARGINS - Co said higher Trio production volumes and a 33% increase in Trio gross margin supported improved profitability, per CEO Kevin Crutchfield
TRIO PRICING - Co said higher average realized prices for Trio, especially for sulfate and low-chloride potassium, contributed to segment sales growth
POTASH SALES MIX - Co said lower potash sales volumes due to shipment timing were partly offset by higher average realized prices
